social_circle.name: Gloria Cooper

background.how_they_met: She is Kweku's mother and raised him in Blountstown with his father and siblings.
background.why_close: They are close through family obligation, church tradition, practical caregiving, and living nearby. Kweku checks on her regularly and helps with groceries, appointments, medicine pickup, and small house tasks.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short practical messages, often with full sentences, reminders, prayerful language, and occasional phone calls when something needs explaining.

shared_activities: talking about church people and relatives
recent_text_topics: Reminders about diabetes and blood pressure appointments, pharmacy pickups, and whether she needs groceries.
Plans for Kweku to come by Sunday or Monday after work or church.
Family updates, church homecomings, prayer requests, and checking whether rising prices are stretching anyone too thin.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Kweku's mother lives nearby and he checks on her a couple times a week by phone and in person on Sunday or Monday. Q35 says she has diabetes and blood pressure issues and he helps with appointments, rides, and medicine pickup. Q47 says he sometimes goes to her Missionary Baptist church.

social_circle.name: Tasha Cooper Williams

background.how_they_met: She is Kweku's older sister; they grew up together in the same Blountstown household.
background.why_close: They are not in each other's business daily, but they show up for each other when family needs arise. She coordinates more of their mother's health scheduling, and Kweku trusts her enough to talk about stress.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete but quick sentences, often task-focused. She sends appointment times, kid updates, and direct advice, with little patience for vague plans.

shared_activities: private conversations about stress and fairness
recent_text_topics: Coordinating their mother's appointments, bills, and pharmacy needs.
Kweku visiting Marianna for a birthday or school event and bringing practical gifts for the kids.
Talking about prices, family stress, and how her kids will experience driving, policing, and growing up in the area.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Kweku has an older sister in Marianna with two kids and that they show up if something happens. Q35 says his sister does more hands-on scheduling for their mother's health. Q45 says he would probably talk first to his sister or Marcus if stress got worse. Q30 says his sister is more direct about race and policing because she has kids.

social_circle.name: Jamal Cooper

demographics.education: High school diploma and trade certification

background.how_they_met: He is Kweku's younger brother; they grew up together in Blountstown.
background.why_close: They have different personalities, but maintain a steady sibling connection through sports, family news, and checking in by text.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually, uses short bursts, sports slang, memes, and more social-media links than Kweku would send.

shared_activities: checking on their mother through sibling updates
recent_text_topics: Jaguars offseason talk, game clips, and whether the team is finally putting things together.
Family updates from Blountstown and Tallahassee.
Occasional political or policing stories Jamal saw online, with Kweku responding more cautiously.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Kweku has a younger brother closer to Tallahassee, that they talk maybe once every week or two, usually by text, and that they connect over sports, especially the Jaguars. Q30 says his brother posts more online than Kweku about race and policing.

social_circle.name: Marcus Benton

background.how_they_met: They met locally through fishing circles and mutual community connections around Blountstown and the Apalachicola River.
background.why_close: Marcus is Kweku's closest friend because they share quiet outdoor routines, patience, and a low-pressure way of spending time together.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts briefly and plainly, often just times, locations, fish reports, or a one-line joke. He does not force emotional talk but answers when Kweku reaches out.

shared_activities: private conversations about stress or race
recent_text_topics: Early morning fishing plans, river level, bait, and whether sunrise will be worth it.
Kweku's holiday conflict at work and using fishing to cool down before addressing his manager.
Jaguars talk, local gossip, and keeping political conversations off Facebook.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Marcus is probably Kweku's closest friend and that they can sit on the riverbank without forcing conversation. Q44 says Kweku texted Marcus about fishing during a rough work period. Q30 says Kweku talks to Marcus about race and policing.

social_circle.name: Denise Carter

demographics.occupation: Customer service desk associate at a regional department store
demographics.education: High school diploma and workplace customer-service training

background.how_they_met: They met at the regional department store where both work; Denise works customer service and Kweku works the sales floor, inventory, returns, and merchandising.
background.why_close: Kweku trusts Denise because she is competent, calm with difficult returns, and understands the store's pressure without turning everything into gossip. Their friendship plausibly extends into personal texts because Kweku identifies her as one of the coworkers he trusts.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in neat sentences with occasional laughing abbreviations. She is direct, gives quick advice, and uses personal SMS for schedule-adjacent favors, breakfast plans, and checking in after hard shifts.

shared_activities: occasional local errands or sale tips
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Kweku is okay after rough holiday-season customer interactions.
Store gossip kept off official channels, especially returns problems and sloppy inventory work.
Breakfast plans before an opening shift and reminders about sales numbers Kweku wants management to notice.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Kweku has a couple coworkers he trusts, especially Denise at customer service because she knows returns better than anybody, and that people in his circle sometimes meet for breakfast before work. Q77 names Denise as a close coworker. Q65 and Q16 describe the shared retail environment around returns, inventory, and customer service.
